Meta.homeTitle: Dalbang · Monthly Rooms & Long Stays in Seoul
Meta.homeDescription: Find a room in Seoul by the month. Share houses, studios and apartments for stays of 30 nights or more — clear prices, English support, request online.
Meta.roomsDescription: Browse share house rooms, studios and apartments for stays of 30+ nights across Seoul.

Demo.banner: Portfolio demo — listings are sample data.

Footer.about: Dalbang (달방) — the Korean way to rent a room by the month.
Footer.demo: This site is a portfolio project. Listings, photos and prices are for demonstration only.

Home.headline: Your home in Seoul, by the month
Home.sub: Rooms in share houses, studios and apartments for stays of 30 nights or more. See the full price upfront and request your dates online.
Home.step1Body: Search by neighborhood, move-in date and budget. Every room shows rent, deposit and fees.
Home.step2Body: Pick your dates (30 nights minimum) and send a booking request. No payment needed.
Home.step3Body: We check your request and reply by email with next steps for moving in.
Home.whatIsBody: In Korean, dal (달) means month and bang (방) means room. A dalbang is a room you rent month to month — no long lease, no Korean bank account needed to start.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.metaDescription: What personal data Dalbang collects, why, how long we keep it and how to ask us to delete it.
Privacy.intro: Dalbang is a portfolio project that lets you send booking requests for monthly rooms in Seoul. This page explains what we collect and why. To ask anything about your data, {contact}.

p: When you send a booking request: your name, email address, number of guests, dates, and — only if you choose to give them — phone or WhatsApp number, nationality and a message to the host. We also record the time you agreed to this policy.
We do not ask for passport numbers, ID cards or payment details.
Only to handle your booking request: to show it to the host, to email you about the result, and to let you check its status with your booking number and email.
Approved or cancelled bookings: until 1 year after the move-out date. Declined or expired requests: 6 months after the decision.
After that, your name, email, phone, nationality and message are deleted automatically. Only the dates and price stay, without anything that identifies you.
Supabase stores the booking database in Seoul, South Korea. Vercel (USA) runs the website, with its server in Seoul. Google (USA) sends our emails through Gmail.
Because some of these companies are based outside Korea, your data may be processed abroad under their security and privacy terms.
Guests are not tracked. We use no advertising or analytics cookies. Only the admin sign-in uses a cookie to keep staff signed in.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time — {contact}. We will reply within 10 days.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.metaDescription: How booking requests on Dalbang work: requests are not contracts, no payment is taken, and how cancellations work.
Terms.intro: Please read these terms before sending a booking request. Questions? {contact}.

p: Dalbang is a portfolio project. The listings, photos and prices are samples for demonstration. Please don’t plan a real move based on them.

sections.h: A request is not a booking
p: Sending a request does not create a rental contract and no payment is taken. A booking is confirmed only when the host approves it and you receive an approval email.
Requests that are not reviewed within 3 days, or whose move-in date has passed, expire automatically.

The total shown includes monthly rent, rent for extra days, the monthly maintenance fee and a one-time deposit. The price is saved at the time of your request; later price changes don’t affect it. The deposit is returned when you move out, after the host checks the room.
To cancel or change an approved booking, {contact} with your booking number. The host will explain any cancellation conditions before you pay anything.
Hosts are responsible for having the licences or contracts required by Korean law to rent their rooms to foreign guests.
Please don’t send false requests or use automated tools to send requests. We may block requests that look like spam.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.metaDescription: Answers about deposits, minimum stays, move-in, payment and visas for monthly rooms in Seoul.
Faq.intro: Short answers to common questions. Can’t find yours? {contact}.

p: 30 nights. Some rooms ask for longer stays — you’ll see it on the room page. The maximum is 12 months.

sections.h: Do I pay when I send a request?
p: No. Sending a request is free. If the host approves it, they will explain how to pay the deposit and first month’s rent.
A one-time amount the host keeps while you stay. You get it back when you move out, minus the cost of any damage.

sections.h: What does the maintenance fee cover?
p: Usually shared utilities and cleaning of shared spaces. It is charged per full month only — there is no fee for extra days.
Monthly rent × full months + daily rent × extra days + maintenance fee × full months + the deposit. Daily rent is the monthly rent divided by 30.
From tomorrow up to 12 months ahead. Your move-out date is free for the next guest, so you can move in on the day someone else moves out.
It depends on your nationality and the purpose of your stay. Dalbang can’t give visa advice — please check with the Korean embassy in your country or the HiKorea website.

sections.h: How do I check my request?
p: Use “Check your booking” at the bottom of any page with your booking number and the email you used.
